title: Patient Care Desk Guidance: Authorization to Refill Prescriptions
content:
A refill under Kestrel Prescriptions is dispensed only on a prescription that the records show can still be refilled, and it uses up authorized refills.

## The rule

- A refill is dispensed only while the prescription is in active status.
- A refill is dispensed only when the prescription's remaining refills are at least 1.
- A refill is dispensed no later than the date the prescriber wrote the prescription plus the prescription validity days, counted in calendar days with the written date as day 0; the last day of validity itself qualifies.
- A refill consumes a number of refills equal to its days supply dispensed divided by the prescription's written days supply and rounded up to a whole number.
- A refill larger than the written days supply is dispensed only where the class allows a 90-day supply and the remaining refills are at least that number.
- When the remaining refills are 0 or the prescription has expired, the patient is offered a renewal request under the Prescriptions renewal request rule instead.

All three gates are read from the prescription record — its status, its remaining refills and its written date — not from the patient's account.

## Gate table (hypothetical records)

| Status | Remaining refills | Within validity | Refill |
|---|---|---|---|
| active | 2 | yes | may be dispensed |
| active | 0 | yes | not dispensed; renewal request offered |
| expired | 3 | no | not dispensed; renewal request offered |
| received | 4 | yes | not dispensed as a refill (status is not active) |

## Refills consumed (hypothetical written days supply of 30)

| Days supply of the refill | Refills consumed |
|---|---|
| 30 | 1 |
| 45 | 2 (1.5 rounded up) |
| 90 | 3 — dispensed only where the class allows a 90-day supply and at least 3 refills remain |

**A patient with one refill left asks for a 90-day refill on a 30-day prescription. What does the rule say?** A 90-day refill consumes 3 refills, and a refill larger than the written days supply is dispensed only where the remaining refills are at least that number; with 1 refill remaining it is not dispensed.
